questions.question:
The status line names whom the session waits on.
It shows above every question.

Now: the label names the role.
Change later: edit the interview page.

Should the label name the role as well as the number?

options.label: Role and number
options.description: It says whom the question is for and where you are in the interview. It costs a few characters.

options.label: Number only
options.description: The label is shorter and the status line says whom it is for, so nothing is lost.

options.label: Role only
options.description: The label says whom. You lose your place.
